explanation: EXCLURAD ran to completion with the documented standard CLAS12 eta settings (model 3, full O(alpha) corrections, 6.53 GeV beam momentum, stationary target, electron beam, detected recoil proton, and vcut = 0.166 GeV^2). It wrote sigma_Born as 0.0008651649 in radtot.dat. It wrote NaN for delta because the full radiated-cross-section integration produced NaN; therefore delta is recorded as null rather than as a valid number.
